report.explanation: All current telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 62ms, gateway/order/payment logs show 200 ok, error_rate 0.001, p95 74ms, zero db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts. No taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is supported. The order deployment record alone cannot establish deployment-caused latency. Alert is not corroborated by current evidence; hand off.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing the actual degraded checkout signal (elevated error rate or latency) aligned to the alert window
Per-service latency/error breakdown isolating which hop degrades
Evidence of db pool saturation, redis timeouts, or downstream latency if any
Memory retention trend over time to assess a leak
Configuration diff or validation failure evidence for bad-configuration
